head: Apple Fitness+ adds Gym Strength plans for weight training
dek: Apple Fitness+ is testing Gym Strength, which builds four-week strength plans from your goals, schedule and equipment, and adapts each week to the reps and weight you log. It's in beta with iOS 27.3.
details: Workouts take about 20-30 or 45-60 minutes, with video demos from three angles. It has over 350 exercises for more than 30 kinds of equipment; dumbbells are the minimum. An Apple Watch can log reps and weight. It's included in the Fitness+ subscription.
where: Fitness+ subscribers, iPhone or iPad on iOS 27.3
means: If you pay for Fitness+ and lift weights, you get a plan that changes with your progress.
todo: It needs iOS 27.3, due in December; then open Fitness+ and look for Gym Strength.
